item_name: Nutritional Approaches — Z. None of the above

lookback_source.quote: Check all nutritional approaches performed after admission/entry or reentry to the facility and within the 7-day look-back period.

lookback_notes: The observation window for Columns 2 and 3 is stated as the 7-day look-back period (Column 2 = performed prior to admission/entry or reentry and within the 7-day look-back; Column 3 = performed after admission/entry or reentry and within the 7-day look-back). Two additional, different windows are stated for the other columns: Column 1 covers the first 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay (assessment period is days 1 through 3 of the SNF PPS Stay starting with A2400B) and Column 4 covers the last 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay (ending on A2400C). Because K0520Z is checked when none of K0520A–D apply in the applicable column, the window depends on the column being coded.

coding_levels.label: None of the above
coding_levels.definition: Checked when none of the listed nutritional approaches (K0520A parenteral/IV feeding, K0520B feeding tube, K0520C mechanically altered diet, K0520D therapeutic diet) apply for the applicable column.

coding_levels.label: None of the above — Column 1, On Admission
coding_levels.definition: No listed nutritional approach was performed during the first 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay (assessment period is days 1 through 3 of the SNF PPS Stay starting with A2400B).

source.quote: Assessment period is days 1 through 3 of the SNF PPS Stay starting with A2400B

coding_levels.label: None of the above — Column 2, While Not a Resident
coding_levels.definition: No listed nutritional approach was performed while NOT a resident of this facility and within the last 7 days; column left blank if resident last entered 7 or more days ago.

source.quote: Only check column 2 if resident entered (admission or reentry) IN THE LAST 7 DAYS. If resident last entered 7 or more days ago, leave column 2 blank.

coding_levels.label: None of the above — Column 3, While a Resident
coding_levels.definition: No listed nutritional approach was performed while a resident of this facility and within the last 7 days.

source.quote: Performed while a resident of this facility and within the last 7 days

coding_levels.label: None of the above — Column 4, At Discharge
coding_levels.definition: No listed nutritional approach was performed within the last 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay ending on A2400C.

source.quote: Assessment period is the last 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay ending on A2400C

federal_coding_rules.rule: K0520 is a check-all-that-apply item; if none of the listed nutritional approaches apply, check K0520Z, None of the above.

source.quote: Check all that apply. If none apply, check K0520Z, None of the above

federal_coding_rules.rule: During assessment, review the medical record to determine whether any listed nutritional approach was performed during the look-back period; if none apply, check K0520Z.

source.quote: If none apply, check K0520Z. None of the above.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Column 1 (On Admission) reflects nutritional approaches performed during the first 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay.

source.quote: Check all nutritional approaches performed during the first 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Column 2 (While Not a Resident) reflects approaches performed prior to admission/entry or reentry and within the 7-day look-back period; leave Column 2 blank if the resident was admitted/entered or reentered the facility more than 7 days ago.

source.quote: Check all nutritional approaches performed prior to admission/entry or reentry to the facility and within the 7-day look-back period. Leave Column 2 blank if the resident was admitted/entered or reentered the facility more than 7 days ago.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Column 3 (While a Resident) reflects approaches performed after admission/entry or reentry to the facility and within the 7-day look-back period.

source.quote: Check all nutritional approaches performed after admission/entry or reentry to the facility and within the 7-day look-back period.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Column 4 (At Discharge) reflects approaches performed within the last 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay.

source.quote: Check all nutritional approaches performed within the last 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay.

federal_coding_rules.rule: When completing the Interim Payment Assessment (IPA), completion of K0520A, K0520B, and K0520Z is required.

source.quote: When completing the Interim Payment Assessment (IPA), the completion of items K0520A, K0520B, and K0520Z is required.

federal_coding_rules.rule: The item table directs the assessor to check all of the nutritional approaches that apply, with Z. None of the above available in each of the four columns.

source.quote: Check all of the following nutritional approaches that apply

federal.criterion: Medical record review must support that none of the listed nutritional approaches (parenteral/IV feeding, feeding tube, mechanically altered diet, therapeutic diet) were performed during the applicable look-back period before checking K0520Z.

source.quote: Review the medical record to determine if any of the listed nutritional approaches were performed during the look-back period.

federal.notes: Stated as a Step for Assessment for K0520.

case_mix_relevance.notes: The manual explicitly requires completion of K0520Z on the Interim Payment Assessment (IPA), a payment assessment, and defines Columns 1 and 4 in terms of the SNF PPS Stay. The pages do not state that K0520Z itself drives a case-mix classification group.

source.quote: When completing the Interim Payment Assessment (IPA), the completion of items K0520A, K0520B, and K0520Z is required.

conflicts.topic: Coexisting observation windows for K0520 columns (7-day look-back vs. 3-day SNF PPS Stay windows)

positions.claim: Columns 2 and 3 use a 7-day look-back period.

source.quote: Check all nutritional approaches performed after admission/entry or reentry to the facility and within the 7-day look-back period.

positions.claim: Column 1 uses the first 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay and Column 4 uses the last 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay.

source.quote: Check all nutritional approaches performed during the first 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay.

positions.claim: The item table states Column 4's assessment period is the last 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay ending on A2400C.

source.quote: Assessment period is the last 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay ending on A2400C

conflicts.resolution: Not a contradiction in the document: the manual assigns a distinct window to each column, so the applicable window for K0520Z depends on which column is being coded. Surfaced so users apply the correct per-column window.
